faculty.name: Mark Aakhus
faculty.summary: Studies argumentation and communication design in organizational and digital decision-making using discourse analysis, digital ethnography, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用话语分析、数字民族志与计算方法，研究组织与数字环境中决策过程里的论辩与传播设计。

faculty.name: Galina Bolden
faculty.summary: Studies how speakers build mutual understanding and relationships in Russian and English talk-in-interaction using conversation analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用会话分析方法，研究俄语与英语日常及机构互动中人们如何达成相互理解并建构人际关系。

faculty.name: Marya L. Doerfel
faculty.summary: Studies community resilience by analyzing how interorganizational network relationships respond to disruptions, using social network analysis and theory building.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与理论建构，研究组织间网络关系如何应对冲击并塑造社区韧性。

faculty.name: J. Sophia Fu
faculty.summary: Studies hybrid organizing, examining how nonprofits and social actors integrate competing goals, platforms, and institutional logics, using network and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用网络与计算方法，研究非营利组织等社会行动者如何整合相互竞争的目标、平台与制度逻辑的混合式组织过程。

faculty.name: Kathryn Greene
faculty.summary: Builds and tests theory on health information disclosure and message engagement to promote prevention behaviors, including youth substance-use prevention programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 建构并检验关于健康信息披露与讯息参与的理论，以促进预防行为，包括青少年物质滥用预防项目。

faculty.name: Shawnika Hull
faculty.summary: Studies how communication can reduce HIV-related health inequities, developing community-engaged prevention interventions and campaigns, including PrEP for Black women.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播如何减少与HIV相关的健康不平等，与社区合作开发预防干预和宣传活动，包括面向黑人女性的PrEP推广。

faculty.name: William Klein
faculty.summary: Studies how people perceive, avoid, and respond to health risk information, drawing on social psychology to improve risk communication and health decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 借助社会心理学研究人们如何感知、回避和回应健康风险信息，以改进风险传播与健康决策。

faculty.name: Jeffrey Lane
faculty.summary: Studies technology use in urban life, youth culture, and criminal justice using urban and digital ethnography alongside surveys and mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用城市与数字民族志以及调查和混合方法，研究城市生活、青年文化与刑事司法中的技术使用。

faculty.name: Eu Gene Lee
faculty.summary: Studies how AI-driven algorithmic management and AI agents shape workers' perceptions, relationships, and well-being in organizations and the gig economy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能驱动的算法管理与AI代理如何影响组织和零工经济中员工的认知、关系与福祉。

faculty.name: Jianing Li
faculty.summary: Studies how people seek, evaluate, and discuss information in digital media, focusing on credibility, misinformation, and media literacy, using computational and survey methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用计算与定量方法，研究人们在数字媒体中如何寻求、评估和讨论信息，关注可信度、虚假信息与媒介素养。

faculty.name: Matthew Matsaganis
faculty.summary: Studies how communities, clinics, and institutions build communication infrastructure for health, equity, and resilience in U.S. and Greek settings, including ethnic media.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国与希腊的社区、诊所和机构如何构建支撑健康、公平与韧性的传播基础设施，包括族裔媒体。

faculty.name: Lisa Mikesell
faculty.summary: Studies patient engagement and patient-clinician interaction in mental health and clinical care by analyzing everyday interactional practices in community and clinic settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过分析社区与诊所中的日常互动实践，研究心理健康和临床照护中的患者参与及医患互动。

faculty.name: Nitzan Navick
faculty.summary: Studies how communication technologies and changing workplace norms affect digital workers' well-being and belonging, and how organizations foster inclusion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播技术与不断变化的职场规范如何影响数字工作者的福祉与归属感，以及组织如何促进包容。

faculty.name: Katherine (Katya) Ognyanova
faculty.summary: Studies misinformation, trust in institutions, public opinion, and attitudes toward AI using large-scale surveys, network science, and computational social science.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用大规模调查、网络科学与计算社会科学，研究虚假信息、机构信任、舆论以及公众对人工智能的态度。

faculty.name: Yonaira Rivera
faculty.summary: Studies health communication for Latino/a/x and underserved communities, including social media health information, multilingual interventions, and LLM-delivered health information.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究面向拉丁裔及弱势社群的健康传播，包括社交媒体健康信息、多语种干预以及大语言模型传递的健康信息。

faculty.name: Kristina Scharp
faculty.summary: Studies marginalization, resilience, and relational distancing in families and health contexts, building communication theory and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究家庭与健康情境中的边缘化、韧性与关系疏离，并发展传播理论与质性研究方法。

faculty.name: Sarah Shugars
faculty.summary: Studies how everyday people talk about and shape public life, developing computational text and network methods grounded in deliberative democracy.
faculty.summary_zh: 立足协商民主理论，开发计算文本与网络方法，研究普通人如何讨论并塑造公共生活。

faculty.name: Jennifer Theiss
faculty.summary: Studies how communication shapes romantic and family relationships during transitions, advancing relational turbulence theory with longitudinal and dyadic designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用纵向与二元数据设计，研究转型期恋爱与家庭关系中的沟通，并发展关系动荡理论。

faculty.name: Maria Venetis
faculty.summary: Studies how patients, clinicians, couples, and families communicate about health issues and how dyadic communication supports well-being and resilience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究患者、医生、伴侣与家庭如何就健康问题进行沟通，以及二元沟通如何促进福祉与韧性。

faculty.name: Matthew Weber
faculty.summary: Studies organizational change and local news ecosystems using network analysis, archival research, interviews, and AI-driven large-scale data methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用网络分析、档案研究、访谈和人工智能驱动的大规模数据方法，研究组织变革与地方新闻生态系统。

faculty.name: DaJung (DJ) Woo
faculty.summary: Studies organizational socialization, interprofessional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement, including generative AI's role, using primarily qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 主要运用质性方法，研究组织社会化、跨专业协作与利益相关者参与，以及生成式人工智能在其中的作用。

faculty.name: Itzhak Yanovitzky
faculty.summary: Studies behavior change communication and how knowledge brokers help evidence inform health policy and practice, using mixed methods and program evaluation.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用混合方法与项目评估，研究行为改变传播以及知识中介如何推动证据进入健康政策与实践。

faculty.name: Melissa Aronczyk
faculty.summary: Critically examines organized persuasion, public relations, and promotional culture, including the politics of environmentalism and nation branding.
faculty.summary_zh: 以批判视角研究有组织的说服、公共关系与推广文化，包括环保主义政治与国家品牌塑造。

faculty.name: Jack Bratich
faculty.summary: Applies social and political theory to popular and political culture, studying social movements, conspiracy culture, microfascism, and far-right digital cultures.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用社会与政治理论研究流行文化与政治文化，关注社会运动、阴谋论文化、微观法西斯主义与极右翼数字文化。

faculty.name: Lauren Feldman
faculty.summary: Studies media effects on public knowledge and opinion about climate change, partisan media and misinformation, and the role of comedy in social change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒体对公众关于气候变化的知识与态度的影响、党派媒体与虚假信息，以及喜剧在社会变革中的作用。

faculty.name: Brooklyne Gipson
faculty.summary: Studies racialized disinformation and anti-Black discourse in Black social media spaces through Black feminist technology studies, digital ethnography, and discourse analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 从黑人女性主义技术研究视角，运用数字民族志与话语分析，研究黑人社交媒体空间中的种族化虚假信息与反黑人话语。

faculty.name: David Greenberg
faculty.summary: Studies the history of American politics, the presidency, political spin, and journalism since 1900 through historical research and biography.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过历史研究与传记写作，研究1900年以来的美国政治史、总统制、政治公关与新闻业。

faculty.name: Amy Jordan
faculty.summary: Studies how media shape children's and adolescents' development, family life, and health, and designs and tests culturally sensitive health media campaigns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介如何影响儿童与青少年的发展、家庭生活与健康，并设计和测试具文化敏感性的健康媒体宣传活动。

faculty.name: Susan Keith
faculty.summary: Studies journalism in transition and conflict, including visual coverage of war, journalistic norms, media law, and journalism education, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性与定量方法，研究转型与冲突中的新闻业，包括战争视觉报道、新闻规范、媒体法与新闻教育。

faculty.name: Youngrim Kim
faculty.summary: Studies the politics of datafication, digital infrastructures, and platform governance from global perspectives, using qualitative and interpretive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释方法，从全球与跨国视角研究数据化政治、数字基础设施与平台治理。

faculty.name: Deepa Kumar
faculty.summary: Studies anti-Muslim racism, Islamophobia, and the politics of empire, with attention to race, gender, and media, through critical analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 以批判分析方法研究反穆斯林种族主义、伊斯兰恐惧症与帝国政治，关注种族、性别与媒介。

faculty.name: Dafna Lemish
faculty.summary: Studies the role of media in children's lives and gender identity formation from global, cross-cultural, and multi-method perspectives.
faculty.summary_zh: 从全球、跨文化和多方法视角，研究媒介在儿童生活及性别认同形成中的作用。

faculty.name: Regina Marchi
faculty.summary: Studies alternative and activist media and civic engagement among marginalized communities and youth, including Latinx public art and media activism in Ireland.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘化社群与青年中的另类媒体、行动主义媒体和公民参与，包括拉丁裔公共艺术与爱尔兰的媒体行动主义。

faculty.name: John V. Pavlik
faculty.summary: Studies how emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, transform journalism content, newsroom practices, media organization, and media-public relations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新兴技术，尤其是人工智能，如何改变新闻内容、新闻编辑室实践、媒体组织以及媒体与公众的关系。

faculty.name: Celeste Wagner
faculty.summary: Studies why people embrace or resist feminist and social change and how audiences engage news and misinformation, using cross-national surveys, experiments, and interviews.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用跨国调查、实验与访谈，研究人们为何接受或抵制女性主义等社会变革，以及受众如何接触新闻与虚假信息。

faculty.name: Khadijah Costley White
faculty.summary: Studies race, gender, and social change in news and popular media, analyzing how journalism shapes understandings of activism and democracy through cultural studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 以文化研究视角，研究新闻与流行媒介中的种族、性别与社会变革，分析新闻业如何塑造对行动主义和民主的理解。

faculty.name: Todd Wolfson
faculty.summary: Conducts traditional and cyber-based ethnographic research, drawing on training in anthropology; specific topical focus is not described in the profile.
faculty.summary_zh: 基于人类学训练开展传统与网络民族志研究；个人简介未说明具体研究主题。
